name: app-store-connect
description: Use App Store Connect through agent documentation and an authenticated Python REST CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Manage App Store Connect with a Python CLI.
interface.longDescription: Find endpoint details in Apple's documentation and use a local Python CLI to read reports and manage App Store Connect resources. Credentials stay in the OS secret store; high-impact requests require local browser approval.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use App Store Connect to manage my apps and reports.
